capabilities.name: structures.place
capabilities.description: A saved structure's placement goes as its own region-edit op (RegionEditOp::Structure, the Paste body), which the server refuses where the world's mode lacks the `structures` ability (shared/modes/modes.json; STRUCTURES.md §9). Without it a client sends plain pastes.

capabilities.name: grid.frames
capabilities.description: The player's grid travels on the wire (docs/proposals/MOON_WORLD.md §7.2): a snapshot ends with the local player's grid (its index in shared/worldgen/grids.json, 0 the home grid) and, off home, the grid's frame (origin, rotation); the other grids' chunks arrive as ChunkData and ChunkUnload ending with their grid byte. Without it the server sends neither, and a player off home is seen at their world position.

capabilities.name: damage.chunks
capabilities.description: A Damage message's cells end with each hit mark's chunk (docs/BLOCK_DAMAGE.md §9: how big a piece the hit took off, in sixteenths of the block's mark; a metal tool's 32, owner 2026-11-12 "Metal tools break double sized bigger chunks off"). Without it the server sends none and the client draws every mark at ×1.

capabilities.name: creatures.npcs
capabilities.description: A Creatures message ends with its NPCs' part (WORK_QUEUE item 38, CHARACTERS.md §11.11): per NPC its id, kind name, idle pose (stand, look, sit) and palette variant seed, from which the client picks the NPC's colours by shared/creatures/creatures.json. Without it the server leaves the part out, and an NPC is drawn as its model's plain creature.

capabilities.name: weapons.clash
capabilities.description: Swordplay on the wire (WORK_QUEUE item 35, round 2): the server sends `Swordplay` (each strike's outcome, blocked / glanced / connected, where, and both stances, to clients within the weapon's `clash.hearM`; and who holds a raised guard in which stance, players and NPCs), and the client says its raised block with `ChopAction::Guard`. Without it neither is sent: an older client sees no clash and no raised swords, and an older server is never sent a guard.

capabilities.name: creatures.poses
capabilities.description: A Creatures message ends, after its NPCs' part (written empty if need be), with the animals' idle poses (WORK_QUEUE item 39): per creature its id and pose (stand, graze, lookUp, earFlick, sit, lie; the ecology's idle poses), drawn as the model's `poses` data (shared/models/models.json) blended over its idle clip. Without it the server leaves the part out and the animals play their idle clip.
